text:
Nina: Oncall flagged confusion: rollout UI shows 'fallback active' but no explanation. Ops can't tie it back to an audit row.
Raj: We dropped event_id from the client after security review. Backend still emits `{"decision":"fallback","reason":"err_rate","event_id":"evt:2823456789"}`.
Leah: UX suggestion: surface a short, ACL-gated trace link instead of raw ids. Call it a "trace token". Clicking opens audit only if user has the right role.
Tom: Backend can mint `trace_token` (opaque, TTL'd) and `sample_rate` + `trigger_counts`. Example payload: `{"trace_token":"tkn_0b3f","sample_rate":"0.05","trigger_counts":"{\"err_rate\":3,\"timeout\":1}"}` — safe to show.
Nina: Love that. Also operators asked for quick context: which rule fired (name + version), which trigger matched, and whether it was sampled.
Leah: Flyout idea: header with rule name + badge (v2), then line: "Trigger: err_rate (5s window)"; small row: "Sampled: yes (1/20)" and a sanitized example.
Raj: Important: sanitized example must be produced server-side. We'll return `sanitized_example` (first 30 chars, redact emails/keys). No raw prompt in client.
Tom: Implementation note: store mapping hash(event_id)->event_id in audit DB, mint HMAC(trace_token) -> mapping, ttl=12h by default. Token endpoint checks ACL then returns audit URL.
Leah: Also the degrade labels are inconsistent across console and docs. Ops keep asking what 'soft-cut' is. Propose canonical lexicon: Graceful (reduce quality), Failover (switch model/endpoint), Passthrough (proxy cached response). Each with one-line help text and an icon.
Nina: Agree. We'll surface the lexicon in the rollout details and hover tips. Also add a tiny sparkline of fallback counts by minute.
Tom: I can add a /rollouts/:id/fallbacks/summary that returns bins + top triggers per bin. Keep it lightweight (max 60 bins).
Raj: For storage/traffic control, we'll sample detailed examples at 1-5% by default. UI should show "sampled / total" counts so operators know how representative the examples are.
Leah: UX microcopy: show counts like `Fallbacks: 4 sampled / 89 total` with tooltip explaining sampling and privacy. Also include a CTA for "View audit" which resolves via token and SSO.
AuditBot: audit service: mapped evt:2823456789 -> https://audit.redwood/evt/2823456789 (requires role check). :lock: 
Nina: One more ask: add a replay button on the audit row (internal only) so QA/SE can reproduce the traffic with a sanitized fixture. Must be rate-limited and logged.
Tom: Replay will be gated, require justification param, and record who triggered it. We'll rate-limit per team.
Raj: Security note: don't include user identifiers in trace_token payloads. Token must be opaque and resolvable only via server-side ACL checks.
Leah: I'll prototype the flyout (mock + microcopy) and new label icons. Nina, can you coordinate an operator beta?
Nina: Yep. Small cohort (5 SEs) behind a feature flag. Target: flighting by next Tue.
Tom: ETA: trace_token + counts endpoint by Fri EOD; histogram endpoint early next week.
Raj: I'll add sanitized_example generation and sampling hooks by Thu.
Leah: Sync Thu 11am to review mocks + API contract.
Nina: Thanks team. Goal: make fallbacks explorable without exposing PII and with clear degrade semantics.
Tom: :thumbsup:
Leah: :sparkles:
